SELECT DesignId, DesignName, DesignDesc, SvcCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName, ChangeDate, ChangeId, ChangeName FROM shopion.tStrDesign
AND DesignName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pDesignName}, '%')
AND DesignDesc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pDesignDesc}, '%')
AND SvcCode = #{pSvcCode}
ORDER BY DesignId
